title: Atlas LLM Match Result
description: Result of an LLM pair evaluation (F1: paper vs. idea) or one entry of a bundled reverse search (F2: paper vs. top-k ideas). Architektur Abschn. 8. Wire format only — never persisted; accepting a match writes Markdown (P4). Single source of truth (P6).

reasoning.description: Short justification, shown to the user as part of the proposal.

usages.description: Where in the idea the paper could be used. anchor refers to a section slug of the idea body; anchors are revalidated on display, orphaned ones are flagged, never dropped.

anchor.description: Section slug of the idea body, or null for 'no specific section'.

suggestion.description: What the paper contributes at this point.

anchor_valid.description: Derived on display: does the anchor still exist in the idea body?

idea.description: Idea id this entry refers to (set in F2 batch results).

citekey.description: Library citekey of the evaluated paper.
